allOf.title: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (structured mode, ADR 0021)
allOf.description: The ONLY envelope on every topic this service produces or consumes. Every attribute is REQUIRED in this fleet. Kafka header `content-type: application/cloudevents+json; charset=UTF-8`. W3C trace context travels in the `traceparent`/`tracestate` Kafka headers, never as extension attributes.

id.description: Minted once per domain event and persisted with the outbox row, so a relay redelivery carries the same id. The consumer's de-duplication key.

source.description: `/warehouse/<repo>` of the publisher — `/warehouse/labor-performance` for everything this service publishes, `/warehouse/fulfillment-execution` for TaskCompleted.

type.description: `com.warehouse.<subdomain>.<bounded-context>.<entity>.<EventName>`. Consumers dispatch on the FULL string.

subject.description: Id of the aggregate instance the event is about. Never empty.

time.description: The domain event's occurred-at instant, UTC (RFC 3339).

standard_id.description: The id of the NEW standard record opened by this revision.

previous_expected_seconds.description: The now-closed standard's expected duration, carried so a consumer can see the size of the change without joining back to the prior event.

travel_component_seconds.description: Optional declaration of how much of the NEW (revised) expected_seconds is attributable to travel — always the revision's own value, never carried over from the closed prior standard. Omitted entirely when the revision does not declare one.

handling_unit.description: ADDITIVE (ADR 0035). Describes the NEW standard. Present only when the standard is declared for one handling unit; omitted entirely (not null) for a task-type-only standard.

team_lift_threshold_g.description: ADDITIVE (ADR 0035). CASE standards only: the weight in grams above which a case needs a team lift (two operators). Present only together with team_lift_expected_seconds.

team_lift_expected_seconds.description: ADDITIVE (ADR 0035). CASE standards only: the engineered elapsed seconds of a team lift. Present only together with team_lift_threshold_g.

effective_from.description: When the new standard came into force — the same instant the prior one was closed. The BUSINESS time the projector buckets this event on.
